Item 8.01 Other Events

On September 15, 2026, the registrant announced that its energy storage deployments for the
third quarter reached a record level, and that construction of its second grid-scale battery
factory remains on schedule for initial production in early 2027. The registrant also
announced a planned expansion of its charging network along two additional interstate
corridors. The press release is furnished as an exhibit to this report.

Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits

The following exhibit is furnished with this current report: Exhibit 99.1, press release
dated September 15, 2026, announcing energy storage deployment results and network
expansion plans.
